name: Outlook
description: Connect Hotmail / Outlook.com / Live to search, read, move, draft, send, delete, list/download attachments, and send files you attach. Sending, deleting, and moving require explicit user intent.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to search Hotmail, read mail, download attachments, or send a message with files you provided. Connect an account on the plugin details page first.

outlook.description: Outlook mail operations including list_attachments and download_attachment (needs save_dir). Sending files requires ghost_call dir handover. Sending, deleting, and moving require explicit user intent.
